reason: If it were in the fridge at my bistro I'd grab one once to see what cold-brewed mate tastes like, but my coffee in the morning and water on rides already do the job, so I wouldn't make it a regular thing.
objection: 55 crowns for a can is more than my espresso, and I don't actually need a replacement for energy drinks because I don't drink them in the first place.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked as a pre-ride or pre-run drink that sits better in my stomach than coffee, and came cheaper in a multipack from the e-shop, I could see buying it every weekend.
